verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਗਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਉ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਜੈਸੋ ਦੇਖੈ ਤੈਸੇੋ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhiragan kau jihabaa sravan jau mileh jaiso dhekhai taiseo keh sun gaavahee ||

en.bdb: If eyes get tongue and ears, then whatever it sees and hears with ears, it will then describe the reality and convey it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਅਉ ਲੋਚਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਿਆਲ ਜੈਸੇੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਤੈਸੇੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: sravan jihabaa aau lochan milai dhiaal jaiseo sunai taiseo dhekh keh samajhaavahee ||

en.bdb: If by the kindness of Almighty, the ears get tongue and eyes, then they will speak with tongue, what they see with eyes and hear.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਕਉ ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਉ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਜੈਸੇੋ ਕਹੈ ਤੈਸੇੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਉ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jihabaa kau lochan sravan jau mileh dhev jaiseo kahai taiseo sun dhekh aau dhikhaavahee ||

en.bdb: If the Almighty God bless the tongue with eyes .and ears it will say what it sees with eyes and hears with ears.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨੈਨ ਜੀਹ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਲੋਚਨ ਜੀਹ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਲੋਚਨ ਲਲਚਾਵਹੀ ॥੩੯੭॥
verses.translit_en: nain jeeh sravan sravan lochan jeeh jihabaa na sravan lochan lalachaavahee ||397||

en.bdb: Eyes need assistance of tongue and ears, the ears need assistance of tongue and eyes. But meditating on Naam, the tongue gets dyed in the hue of the Lord. In this state, the tongue never longs for the assistance of the eyes and the ears. (397)
